english.meaning: written music; a musical score or chart
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Tsk, I think his songs are better than Aaron Kwok’s. Aaron Kwok’s songs have no melody or energy. You can’t even tell what he’s singing!
